Checklist (identical for every stock)

IDOversold testThresholdFrameRecent windowRationale
D1Daily RSI-14 ≤ 30≤ 30.0Daily10 sessionsClassic short-term washout
D2Daily Stochastic %K(14,3) ≤ 20≤ 20.0Daily10 sessionsClose pinned at bottom of 3-week range
D3Daily close below lower Bollinger (%B ≤ 0)≤ 0.00Daily10 sessions2σ statistical extreme
D41-yr drawdown ≥ median at prior swing lowsstock-relative: median at own prior swing lowsDaily10 sessionsHas it fallen as far as at previous bottoms?
D5Below 200-d SMA ≥ median at prior swing lowsstock-relative: median at own prior swing lowsDaily10 sessionsTrend stretch comparable to previous bottoms
W1Weekly RSI-14 ≤ 35≤ 35.0Weekly2 weeksIntermediate-term washout, rare for quality names
W2Weekly Stochastic %K(14,3) ≤ 20≤ 20.0Weekly2 weeksPinned at bottom of 14-week range
W3Weekly Bollinger %B ≤ 0.10≤ 0.10Weekly2 weeksHugging/below weekly lower band
W4Weekly RSI-14 in bottom 5% of 4-yr history≤ 5Weekly2 weeksRare reading for this specific stock
W513-week rate of change ≤ −20%≤ -20.0%Weekly2 weeksMomentum crash in one quarter

Turn signals (bonus, counted separately)

  • T1 Daily MACD histogram rising over 3 bars
  • T2 Weekly MACD histogram rising over 3 bars
  • T3 Bullish RSI divergence: lower price low but higher RSI low over ~6 months
  • T4 Daily RSI dipped ≤30 in last 10 sessions and has hooked back above 30

Tiers

  • ≥7 flags → Tier 1 (≥2 turn signals) or Tier 2 (no confirmed turn)
  • 4–6 → Tier 3 partially oversold
  • 2–3 → Tier 4 mild pullback
  • ≤1 → Tier 5 not oversold

Percentiles

Percentile = share of the last 4 years in which the indicator reading was more oversold than today. 0 = most extreme reading in the window, 50 = median. "Pctile recent" applies the same to the lowest reading in the recent window.

Data hygiene

  • Source: Yahoo Finance, split/dividend-adjusted daily OHLCV; weekly bars derived from daily (Friday close).
  • 6 years downloaded; the first 2 years serve only as warm-up so 200-day SMA, 252-day rolling high, Wilder RSI recursion and 40-week SMA are fully formed before the 4-year percentile window begins.
  • Every indicator is computed from raw price/volume only. The single exception, by design, is W4 (percentile rank of weekly RSI).
  • Swing lows = bar whose low is the lowest within ±30 trading days (daily) / ±8 weeks (weekly) and ≥15% below the trailing 1-yr high; last 2 years; the current 45 days are excluded.
  • Episodes = clusters of bars (gap ≤15 d / ≤35 d) when the indicator was at/below the threshold; forward returns measured from the last bar of the episode.
  • Today's daily and weekly bars are partial (intraday) until the close.

  • T1 Daily MACD histogram rising over 3 bars
  • T2 Weekly MACD histogram rising over 3 bars
  • T3 Bullish RSI divergence: lower price low but higher RSI low over ~6 months
  • T4 Daily RSI dipped ≤30 in last 10 sessions and has hooked back above 30

Tiers

  • ≥7 flags → Tier 1 (≥2 turn signals) or Tier 2 (no confirmed turn)
  • 4–6 → Tier 3 partially oversold
  • 2–3 → Tier 4 mild pullback
  • ≤1 → Tier 5 not oversold

Percentiles

Percentile = share of the last 4 years in which the indicator reading was more oversold than today. 0 = most extreme reading in the window, 50 = median. "Pctile recent" applies the same to the lowest reading in the recent window.

Data hygiene

  • Source: Yahoo Finance, split/dividend-adjusted daily OHLCV; weekly bars derived from daily (Friday close).
  • 6 years downloaded; the first 2 years serve only as warm-up so 200-day SMA, 252-day rolling high, Wilder RSI recursion and 40-week SMA are fully formed before the 4-year percentile window begins.
  • Every indicator is computed from raw price/volume only. The single exception, by design, is W4 (percentile rank of weekly RSI).
  • Swing lows = bar whose low is the lowest within ±30 trading days (daily) / ±8 weeks (weekly) and ≥15% below the trailing 1-yr high; last 2 years; the current 45 days are excluded.
  • Episodes = clusters of bars (gap ≤15 d / ≤35 d) when the indicator was at/below the threshold; forward returns measured from the last bar of the episode.
  • Today's daily and weekly bars are partial (intraday) until the close.
